clue.text: Work out message in Christmas-time poem

parts.note: Christmas falls in December, abbreviated DEC
an ode is a lyric poem

explanation.surface: Someone tries to decipher a hidden meaning in a festive verse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' is only a link between definition and wordplay; the message is not inside anything.
explanation.definitionFit: To decipher a coded text is to translate it into plain language.

clue.text: Nearly twice as many love working for a bit of gold

indicators.note: nearly says the word is cut short by its final letter

parts.note: twice as many is double the number
love is zero in tennis scoring, shaped like the letter O
a machine that is working is on

explanation.surface: Someone working for love earns almost double, a little gold.
explanation.definitionFit: A doubloon was an old Spanish gold coin, so a small piece of gold money.

clue.text: Investigating police take in leading matchmaker

indicators.note: take in means the police letters swallow another piece inside them

parts.note: CID is the Criminal Investigation Department, the detective branch of British police
a team that is up is ahead or leading

explanation.surface: Detectives arrest the chief go-between of a romance.
explanation.definitionFit: The Roman god of love is the figure who brings couples together, hence a matchmaker.

clue.text: File for individual held by person sleeping rough

indicators.note: held by puts the single letter inside the word for the rough sleeper

parts.note: a dosser is British slang for a homeless person who sleeps rough
individual means one, written as the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: A homeless man is found carrying a file on somebody.
explanation.definitionFit: A dossier is a file of documents gathered about a person or subject.

clue.text: Ultimately useless dairy product — that's a laugh!

indicators.note: ultimately points to the final letter of the next word

parts.note: cream is a dairy product skimmed from milk

explanation.surface: Someone mocks a worthless dairy product as a joke.
explanation.definitionFit: Calling something a scream means it is hilarious, an informal idiom for a great laugh.

clue.text: Song about one single wine from Italy

indicators.note: about means the song wraps around the next letter

parts.note: a chant is a simple sung melody
one is the Roman numeral I
single is one, written as the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: A singer croons about a lone bottle of Italian red.
explanation.definitionFit: Chianti is a red wine made in the Tuscany region of Italy.

clue.text: Showing feelings, a student supports key movement

indicators.note: in a down clue, the piece that supports another sits beneath it

parts.note: E is one of the musical keys
a motion is a movement
L is the learner plate of a student driver

explanation.surface: A music student plays a key movement with great feeling.
explanation.definitionFit: Emotional means displaying strong feelings openly.

clue.text: Think aloud and slip inside for a healthy breakfast

indicators.note: aloud says the word for think is to be heard, not spelt as usual

parts.note: to muse is to think or ponder

indicators.note: inside asks for the inner letters of the word slip

explanation.surface: Someone thinks out loud and slips in to have a wholesome breakfast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Think aloud' looks like a phrase for musing out loud; 'aloud' turns the thought into a spelling that sounds the same, the first half of the cereal's name.
explanation.definitionFit: Muesli is a mix of oats, nuts and fruit eaten as a nourishing breakfast cereal.

clue.text: Sat artistically by drink and thought

parts.note: to sup is to drink in small mouthfuls
a model posed, sitting for an artist

explanation.surface: A model sat for a painter beside a drink, deep in thought.
explanation.definitionFit: Supposed means thought or assumed, both past tenses of believing something.

clue.text: The differences for a side struggling with spirit

indicators.note: struggling shows the letters thrashing about into a new order

explanation.surface: Gulfs in quality are shown by a team fighting with their spirit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with' just joins the fodder; the letters of A SIDE and SPIRIT are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Disparities are inequalities or gaps between things.

clue.text: Pressed on in dire trouble

indicators.note: in places one piece within the other
trouble shows the letters being disturbed into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone pushed on despite being in dreadful difficulty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pressed on' reads as pushing ahead, but 'Pressed' alone is the definition, as with clothes; 'on' is the inserted piece.
explanation.definitionFit: Clothes that have been pressed have been ironed flat.

clue.text: Cheerful announcement by disheartened girl

indicators.note: disheartened removes the heart, the middle letters, of the word girl

parts.note: an ad is an advertisement, a public announcement

explanation.surface: A sad girl makes a cheerful announcement.
explanation.definitionFit: Glad means happy or pleased.

clue.text: Not feeling level-headed after endless gins

indicators.note: after says the level-headed piece follows the first
endless strips the first and last letters from gins

parts.note: level-headed means sensible and calm

explanation.surface: After too many gins, someone is past feeling sensible.
explanation.definitionFit: Insensible means unconscious or unable to feel, numb.

clue.text: Talk for a time, absorbed by spiritual enlightenment

indicators.note: absorbed by means the short pieces are taken into the longer word

parts.note: a conversion is a religious awakening to a new faith

explanation.surface: Someone talks for a while, absorbed in religious awakening.
explanation.definitionFit: A conversation is an exchange of talk between people.

clue.text: Passive or active sprays

indicators.note: active suggests the letters are set in motion and rearranged

explanation.surface: A grammar note: passive or active voice for a verb meaning sprays.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Passive or active' looks like grammar voices, but 'active' rearranges PASSIVE OR.
explanation.definitionFit: Vaporises means turns to vapour or mist, as a spray does.

clue.text: At home act fast, being lazy!

parts.note: someone at home is in
to do is to act
Lent is the Christian season of fasting

explanation.surface: Doing nothing but fasting at home looks like idleness.
explanation.definitionFit: Indolent means idle and lazy, describing someone being slothful.

clue.text: Undertook to touch down in paradise

parts.note: to undertake to do something is to promise it
an aircraft touching down lands

explanation.surface: A pilot vowed to put down in paradise.
explanation.definitionFit: The Promised Land is the biblical Canaan, used figuratively for an ideal paradise.

clue.text: People who see vehicle brought back amidst Spanish cheers

indicators.note: amidst puts the reversed vehicle in among the Spanish cheers

parts.note: ole is the Spanish cry of approval at a bullfight

indicators.note: brought back means the word is reversed

parts.note: a car is a vehicle

explanation.surface: A car returns among cheering Spanish crowds.
explanation.definitionFit: Oracles are seers, prophets who see the future.

clue.text: Looks with love — soldier's a terrible sight

parts.note: eyes can mean looks at, as a verb
love is zero in tennis, the letter O
RE is the Royal Engineers, British army soldiers

explanation.surface: Someone gazes lovingly but the soldier is an ugly sight.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's of soldier's stands for 'is', linking wordplay to definition.
explanation.definitionFit: An eyesore is something ugly and unpleasant to look at.

clue.text: Meaningless words from popular song

parts.note: hot means popular and in demand
an air is a tune or song

explanation.surface: Empty lyrics come from a chart-topping song.
explanation.definitionFit: Hot air is empty talk with no substance, an idiom.

clue.text: Trip with graduate to Nile failing to get mineral

parts.note: a tour is a trip
MA is a Master of Arts, a graduate degree

indicators.note: failing shows the river's name collapsing into a new order

explanation.surface: A travelling graduate heads to the Nile but fails to find a mineral.
explanation.definitionFit: Tourmaline is a crystalline boron silicate mineral used as a gemstone.

clue.text: Almost explode, seeing blunder

indicators.note: almost says the phrase loses its final letter

parts.note: to go off is to explode

explanation.surface: A near explosion is spotted as a mistake.
explanation.definitionFit: A goof is a silly mistake or blunder.

clue.text: Joke about regularly full Russian prison camp

indicators.note: about means the joke surrounds the picked letters

parts.note: a gag is a joke

indicators.note: regularly takes every other letter of full

explanation.surface: A joke about a packed Soviet labour camp.
explanation.walkthrough: 'full' looks like a description of the camp, but it only supplies alternate letters.
explanation.definitionFit: The Gulag was the Soviet system of forced labour camps.

clue.text: Young girl in sales made returns

indicators.note: returns says the hidden letters are read backwards
the clue word that says the letters sit inside the next words

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A girl is involved in sales and returns at a shop.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' points to letters hidden in SALES MADE, and 'returns' reads them backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Damsel is an old word for a young unmarried woman.

clue.text: Bear — one seen by side of road

definitions.meaning: to bear a burden is to take its weight on one's upper arm joint

definitions.text: one seen by side of road
definitions.meaning: the hard strip at the edge of a motorway, where cars stop

explanation.surface: A bear is spotted at the roadside.
explanation.definitionFit: To shoulder means to bear a load, and the strip along a road's edge has the same name.

clue.text: Remain to cover one's dissent

indicators.note: to cover means the first word goes around the second

parts.note: rest means remain, as in rest assured
one's is I with 's read as is, giving I and S

explanation.surface: Someone stays put to hide their disagreement.
explanation.definitionFit: To resist is to oppose, a verb close to dissent.

clue.text: Importance given to women rowing crew

parts.note: an eight is a rowing boat crew of eight oarsmen

explanation.surface: A women's rowing eight is given due importance.
explanation.definitionFit: Weight means importance or influence, as in carrying weight.
